prompt: Create a high fidelity desktop web application UI design mockup for Ilimmu, a private Genshin Impact companion. Landscape 1536x1024. Actual flat screen, no device frame. Operate mode, clean quiet beautiful compact app like GGArtifact. Deep charcoal navy #10131D canvas, #1B2130 panels, soft warm gold #E3BD73 restrained accents, off-white text, muted slate labels, precise Manrope-like sans UI, elegant understated character headings. Use recognizable full-color Genshin character portraits and weapon/artifact game icons as data thumbnails only, no decorative background art. Left 180px app navigation with Ilimmu name, Characters active, Profile, Weapons, Inventory, Goals, Conflicts, Export. Main heading Characters, subtitle 'Your roster. Your builds.' Search characters, filter Owned / All, element filter, sort Name. No add character button. Each character has an accessible Owned toggle and profile link. One build per character with weapon picker, artifact set picker, Sands / Goblet / Circlet main stat selectors. NO substats, NO weights or 100 numbers, NO DPS/Support selectors, NO on-field/off-field selectors, NO Add Build. Synthetic example content: Furina Hydro Sword Fontaine 5-star owned, level 80; Neuvillette Hydro Catalyst Fontaine 5-star owned level 90; Kaedehara Kazuha Anemo Sword Inazuma 5-star owned level 90; Nahida Dendro Catalyst Sumeru 5-star not owned. Furina weapon Fleuve Cendre Ferryman, artifact Golden Troupe, Sands HP%, Goblet Hydro DMG Bonus, Circlet CRIT Rate. Neuvillette weapon Prototype Amber, artifact Marechaussee Hunter, Sands HP%, Goblet Hydro DMG Bonus, Circlet CRIT DMG. Kazuha Iron Sting, Viridescent Venerer, Elemental Mastery all three slots. Beautiful spacing and readable real labels, low chrome, no metric dashboard. OPTION C: roster with inline focused build editor. Main region split 36% roster list on left and 64% selected character build detail on right; persistent app navigation outside. Left character list shows 7 compact portrait rows with name element and owned toggles; Furina selected with subtle gold emphasis. Right is Furina selected build: large 90px portrait, name and metadata, View profile link. Below: Weapon and Artifact set each with game icon and clear change affordance, then three main stat selectors in a row. Below artifact is unobtrusive set bonus text '2-piece: Elemental Skill DMG +20%' and '4-piece: Increases Elemental Skill DMG. Bonus increases while off-field.' Save build button and saved feedback. Selected character pane sits on flat navy field with whitespace and separators, no floating cards. Top global heading Characters and search bar. Show enough roster context and polished info hierarchy. No numbered option label on screen.
